summary: A notice from MIT that its PDP-10 at Project MAC, the Dynamic Modeling System, would be down for at least ten days from about December 26, 1972, to install a paging system. It may be less available for a few weeks after.

eli5.summary: A computer is going on a holiday break to get an upgrade, and the note warns people that it will be away.

subtitle: A maintenance notice from MIT's Project MAC

tldr.problem: MIT's Dynamic Modeling System at Project MAC needed maintenance during the holiday season.
tldr.mechanism: The system would shut down for at least 10 days around December 26, 1972, to install a new paging system.
tldr.outcome: Network liaisons and users were warned of the downtime and told the system might be less available for a few weeks after the upgrade.

today: This is a historical maintenance notice from the early days of computer networking. The Dynamic Modeling System's paging upgrade proceeded as planned in December 1972.

sections.title: Vacation Notice for MIT-DMS
sections.content: This notice informs network liaisons and station agents that the PDP-10 computer at MIT's Project MAC, known as the Dynamic Modeling System, would take a maintenance break during the holiday season. The system was expected to cease operation on or about December 26, 1972, for at least ten days and possibly as long as three weeks.
sections.eli5: A big computer at MIT is taking a holiday break starting around Christmas 1972.

sections.title: Planned Maintenance Work
sections.content: During the shutdown period, the Dynamic Modeling System would have a paging system installed. This was a major upgrade to the computer's memory management capabilities. Network administrators were warned that even after the system returned to operation, it might not be as available as it had been in the past during the initial weeks while the paging system was being tested and debugged.
sections.eli5: Engineers will install a new system for managing memory while the computer is offline, and it might be slower at first when it comes back.

sections.title: Impact on Network Users
sections.content: Project MAC's Dynamic Modeling System was a resource available to the broader ARPANET community. The notice was directed at network liaisons and station agents so they could inform their users that the system would be unavailable and prepare for reduced service during the recovery period.
sections.eli5: People who use the computer over the network need to know it will be gone and slower when it comes back.
